title: Scope gates: PingFederate token to a Cedar rule and RequiredClaims tiers
lede: A mock PingFederate token carries scopes. The P1 Privilege Agent App checks them twice: RequiredClaims opens a tier of tools, and a Cedar rule can still forbid one tool. Mock only; values invented.

steps.title: Ask with resource
steps.what: The agent sends the agent app URL as resource. Without it a different token manager answers and the gateway cannot find the token (401).

steps.title: Token carries scopes
steps.what: The agent token manager returns sub, act and the requested scopes.

steps.title: Agent calls the app
steps.what: The token is presented as a bearer to the P1 Privilege Agent App.

steps.title: Scopes are split
steps.what: RequiredClaims matches each scope value, not the whole string: opensearch:read matches 'openid opensearch:read'.

steps.title: Tier decides the tool list
steps.what: The admin scope lists nine tools, the read scope three, neither is 403.

steps.title: A tool call reaches Cedar
steps.what: A call to SearchIndexTool is checked by the Cedar rule.

steps.title: Forbid unless scope
steps.what: No opensearch:search scope means JSON-RPC 400 -32600. A policy whose State is not Active only logs a shadow delta and allows.

steps.title: Allowed calls go through
steps.what: Only allowed calls reach the MCP server.
